name: Denomiq
description: Denomiq is an offline-first Indian Rupee cash denomination counter for shops, counters, and cashiers. Enter note and coin quantities, compare against expected cash, see Exact / Short / Excess, save sessions, and export PDF, CSV, TXT, JSON, or Excel reports — all without a login or cloud account.
features: INR notes and coins denomination counter
Expected cash with Exact / Short / Excess status
Opening and closing cash with float
Session history with search, filters, edit, duplicate, delete
Reports and multi-format export (PDF, CSV, TXT, JSON, Excel)
Share, copy, save, print, and Thermal Desk hand-off
Stores/counters presets and hide unused denominations
Home widget and quick Count Cash actions
Light / dark / system theme — works fully offline
Optional Denomiq Pro (ads-free + Excel via Play Billing)

notes: Initial release: cash count, history, reports, exports, Pro unlock, Thermal Desk bridge, home widget
